extras: The plugin has no telemetry or analytics.
problem: Users need a way to leverage powerful LLMs like Claude directly within their local knowledge base while maintaining context and control over generated content.

relations.evidence: CLI sign-in on desktop through Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode.
Anthropic API on desktop or mobile, using your own credential.
Local model through Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Research services: an explicit discovery or import action sends search terms or bibliographic identifiers to OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, or Zotero.

summary: Companion for Claude allows users to chat with Claude inside Obsidian, generating interactive artifacts and syncing vault-aware research back into notes.
